description: Fetch a public tar(.gz) archive over HTTPS and deploy its files to an existing site in one call (begin_deploy, upload and commit_deploy combined). Use deploy_from_url when the files are already published at a public URL, such as a repository archive that holds only the built site (no dotfiles), or when your sandbox reaches the allowed hosts (listed under archiveUrl) but not mcp.vibedeploy.be; otherwise use deploy_site or update_site. In replace mode one top-level folder that wraps every file (as in repository archives) is removed, and a site that already has files needs confirm:"I-want-to-replace-all-files". A failed call never leaves a staging session open.

archiveUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL of a tar or tar.gz archive (max 100 MB, 60 s). Allowed hosts, also for every redirect: github.com, codeload.github.com, *.githubusercontent.com, gist.github.com, gitlab.com, bitbucket.org, codeberg.org, *.amazonaws.com, *.r2.cloudflarestorage.com, *.backblazeb2.com, *.workers.dev, *.pages.dev, transfer.sh, 0x0.st, mcp.vibedeploy.be. GitHub, GitLab and Codeberg archive links (e.g. https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz) are accepted, but the normal file rules apply: any dotfile except .well-known/ (such as .gitignore, .github/, .gitlab-ci.yml) or any file type outside the allowlist (such as .ts, .tsx, .yml) rejects the whole archive with INVALID_FILE_TYPE. Replace mode removes only the one wrapping folder, so the built site must sit at the repository root.

confirm.description: Required only for mode "replace" on a site that already has files. Pass exactly "I-want-to-replace-all-files" to acknowledge that the live files will be deleted and replaced with the archive's files.

mode.description: replace: the archive becomes the whole site (other files are removed). patch: the archive's files are added or overwritten, the rest stays.

name.description: Name of an existing site (see list_sites). This tool does not create sites.

name: deploy_from_url

manageUrl.description: Dashboard page where the user manages this site (domains, versions, settings).

strippedPrefix.description: Top-level folder removed from every archive path (replace mode, when one folder wraps all files).

title: Deploy a site from a public archive URL
